title: Yeti Summit Series Blue Lychee Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Yeti Summit Blue Lychee Ice brings together two unique flavours in a distinctly compelling blend. The syrupy sweetness of Blue Raspberry is balanced by the lighter, tropical character of Lychee, creating a vibrant contrast that’s both punchy and refreshing. Finished with an icy menthol breeze, this nic salt delivers a cool, fruity vape with a clean finish. Made with nicotine salts, this e-liquid ensures swift nicotine delivery and a more comfortable throat hit, ideal for use with low-powered pod kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) starter devices. The 50VG/50PG formulation provides a smooth, flavour-focused experience with discreet vapour and reliable consistency throughout the day. The Yeti Summit Series features double-concentrated nicotine salt e-liquids, each designed to deliver maximum flavour with a bracingly cool twist. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, this convenient 10ml format offers an affordable and lower-waste alternative to single-use disposables—without compromising on quality.
